description: This file defines the DumpUtil class within the torch::lazy namespace, providing static methods for converting graph nodes to various textual or graphical representations such as Dot format and text, as well as generating representations based on backend devices.

classes.name: DumpUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for visualizing and exporting graph nodes and values.

methods.name: ToDot
methods.description: Converts a collection of nodes into the Dot graph format.

methods.name: PostOrderToDot
methods.description: Converts a post-order traversal of nodes into the Dot format, given root nodes.

methods.name: ToText
methods.description: Converts a collection of nodes into a textual representation.

methods.name: PostOrderToText
methods.description: Converts a post-order traversal of nodes into text, given root nodes.

methods.name: ToBackend
methods.description: Generates a representation of values in relation to a specific backend device.
